# pbs_sync_jobs (Data Source)

Lists all PBS sync jobs, optionally filtered by datastore or remote.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `remote` (String) Filter sync jobs by remote name (optional). Local sync jobs have no remote and never match.
- `store` (String) Filter sync jobs by target datastore name (optional).

### Read-Only

- `jobs` (Attributes List) List of sync jobs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--jobs))

<a id="nestedatt--jobs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `jobs`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String)
- `digest` (String)
- `group_filter` (List of String)
- `id` (String)
- `max_depth` (Number)
- `namespace` (String)
- `remote` (String)
- `remote_namespace` (String)
- `remote_store` (String)
- `remove_vanished` (Boolean)
- `schedule` (String)
- `store` (String)
